scope: c01-selection 修复后的真实 Node24 TCP 与浏览器双输入 QA；职业确认、学习抽屉、中文输入路径、焦点、窄屏和迟到响应

tcp.evidence: 真实监听端口业务请求；隔离测试账户与临时数据

checks.evidence: GET / on 127.0.0.1:4391 returned the application home.
Isolated registration returned session cookie and CSRF; formal account untouched.
Agent intent returned candidate with matched signals and source/version fields.
Confirmation wrote active career in the isolated account and opened learning_home.
Replay with the same idempotency key returned the existing confirmation.
React returned ReAct-method and React-framework clarification options.
Opt-in context returned unit/section/source/version; location without opt-in was rejected.
Version snapshots were returned; stale career/content versions returned controlled 409 responses.
Agent goal produced a career card and actions.
React produced the two disambiguation choices.
Pre-confirm state was visible; unauthenticated confirmation routed to registration.
After isolated registration, career confirmation succeeded and opened learning.
Ask-textbook drawer opened and closed while reading remained available.
Closing the drawer returned focus to its launcher.
Chinese ask-textbook query text was entered and reached loading/results; native IME composition is separate insufficient check.
Shift+Enter inserted a newline without submitting.
Enter submitted, showed loading, then rendered answer/source state.
Source action opened the cited textbook section/stable anchor.
Unrelated weather query produced no-match without fabricated textbook content.
At approximately 390px drawer, input and result cards remained operable without observed horizontal overflow.
At approximately 320px long text wrapped and drawer/confirmation/source structure remained reachable.
Direct Chinese text entry was observed; no auditable macOS IME candidate/composition sequence was run.
No controllable delayed service or network interception was used to prove stale response isolation.
VoiceOver/screen-reader order and announcements were not run.

limitations: Native Chinese IME composition is unverified; browser automation text injection is not equivalent.
Late-response isolation is unverified; a delayed A followed by B scenario remains required.
TCP/browser tests used isolated data and did not call an external provider; cross-restart idempotency, production behavior, real learner outcomes and expert review remain unverified.
The prior 23/23 report remains the evidence for its in-process handler and isolated SQLite scope; this report adds separate TCP/browser observations without rewriting that record.
